```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

# =========================================================
# 1) Load saved cluster frequencies
# =========================================================
props_wide <- read.csv(
  "E:/Sam Gamble/Lung_explants/PDTFs_cluster_freqs_190325.csv",
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

names(props_wide)[1] <- "file_name"

# =========================================================
# 2) Load and clean metadata to match the script logic
#    - remove "x" from patient_id
#    - fix ASC353 tissue annotation
# =========================================================
md <- read.csv(
  "E:/Sam Gamble/Flow cytometry clustering/PDTF_190325/metafile_all.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(
    patient_id_raw = patient_id,
    patient_id = gsub("x", "", patient_id),
    tissue = case_when(
      file_name == "export_F07 ASC353x_tumour WLSM_CD4_500.fcs" ~ "parenchyma",
      TRUE ~ tissue
    ),
    tissue = factor(tissue, levels = c("parenchyma", "tumour"))
  ) |>
  select(file_name, patient_id_raw, patient_id, tumour.type, tissue)

# =========================================================
# 3) Long-format cluster frequencies + metadata
# =========================================================
props <- props_wide |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -file_name,
    names_to = "cluster",
    values_to = "freq"
  ) |>
  left_join(md, by = "file_name") |>
  filter(!is.na(patient_id), !is.na(tissue))

# Optional:
# If you want histology-specific analysis, uncomment one of these:
# props <- props |> filter(tumour.type == "LUSC")
# props <- props |> filter(tumour.type == "LUAD")

# =========================================================
# 4) Collapse duplicate files within patient/tissue/cluster
#    This handles ASC353 safely by averaging within tissue
# =========================================================
props_patient <- props |>
  group_by(patient_id, tumour.type, tissue, cluster) |>
  summarise(
    freq = mean(freq, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_files_collapsed = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# =========================================================
# 5) Define patient pairing status AFTER cleaning patient_id
# =========================================================
patient_status <- md |>
  distinct(patient_id, tissue, file_name) |>
  group_by(patient_id) |>
  summarise(
    n_total = n(),
    n_tumour = sum(tissue == "tumour", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_parenchyma = sum(tissue == "parenchyma", na.rm = TRUE),
    strict_pair_status = case_when(
      n_tumour == 1 & n_parenchyma == 1 ~ "strict_pair",
      n_tumour > 1 | n_parenchyma > 1 ~ "duplicate_tissue",
      TRUE ~ "unmatched"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

props_patient <- props_patient |>
  left_join(patient_status, by = "patient_id")

# quick checks
patient_status |> count(strict_pair_status)
props_patient |>
  distinct(patient_id, tissue, strict_pair_status) |>
  count(strict_pair_status, tissue)

# =========================================================
# 6) Helper: plotting function
# =========================================================
plot_volcano <- function(vol_df, plot_title = NULL) {
  ggplot(vol_df, aes(x = fc, y = log10p, fill = sig, size = mean_tumour)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.9, shape = 21, colour = "black", stroke = 0.9) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-0.5, 0.5), linetype = "dashed", colour = "blue") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1.3, linetype = "dashed", colour = "blue") +
    geom_text_repel(
      aes(label = cluster),
      size = 5,
      max.overlaps = 100,
      force = 100,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "q<0.05" = "maroon4",
        "p<0.05" = "darkgoldenrod1",
        "p>0.05" = "black"
      )
    ) +
    scale_size(range = c(4, 14)) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 30, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 30, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 26, colour = "black"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 26, colour = "black"),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black"),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 40, 10, 40),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 20),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 24),
      legend.position = "right",
      axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black"),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = plot_title,
      x = bquote(Log[2](FC)),
      y = bquote(-Log[10](p)),
      fill = "Significance",
      size = "Mean prop. in tumour"
    ) +
    guides(
      fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 10), order = 2),
      size = guide_legend(order = 1)
    )
}

# =========================================================
# 7) Analysis A: strict matched pairs only
#    - exclude duplicate_tissue and unmatched
#    - paired Wilcoxon per cluster
# =========================================================
pseudo <- 1e-6

paired_df <- props_patient |>
  filter(strict_pair_status == "strict_pair") |>
  select(patient_id, cluster, tissue, freq) |>
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(patient_id, cluster),
    names_from = tissue,
    values_from = freq
  ) |>
  drop_na(tumour, parenchyma)

vol_matched <- paired_df |>
  group_by(cluster) |>
  summarise(
    n_pairs = n(),
    mean_parenchyma = mean(parenchyma, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_tumour = mean(tumour, na.rm = TRUE),
    fc = log2((mean_tumour + pseudo) / (mean_parenchyma + pseudo)),
    p_val = if (n() < 2) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      wilcox.test(
        x = tumour,
        y = parenchyma,
        paired = TRUE,
        exact = FALSE
      )$p.value
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    q = p.adjust(p_val, method = "BH"),
    log10p = -log10(p_val),
    sig = case_when(
      q < 0.05 ~ "q<0.05",
      p_val < 0.05 ~ "p<0.05",
      TRUE ~ "p>0.05"
    ),
    sig = factor(sig, levels = c("q<0.05", "p<0.05", "p>0.05"))
  )

p_matched <- plot_volcano(
  vol_matched,
  plot_title = "Matched patients only, paired Wilcoxon"
)

p_matched
ggsave("Fig3E_matched_paired_wilcoxon.pdf", p_matched, dpi = 320, width = 10, height = 8)


############### Figure 3F ###############

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Choose which cluster(s) define BATF Tregs
#    If BATF Tregs are split into 2 clusters, keep both here
# ---------------------------------------------------------
batf_clusters <- c("BATF.Treg.CD177neg", "BATF.Treg.CD177pos")

# If instead you only want one cluster, use for example:
# batf_clusters <- "BATF.Treg.CD177neg"

# Optional quick check
# sort(unique(props_patient$cluster))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Helper to format p values like 7.5 x 10^-5
# ---------------------------------------------------------
format_p_parse <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) {
    return("italic(p) == NA")
  }
  
  if (p == 0) {
    return('italic(p) < 2.2 %*% 10^-16')
  }
  
  exponent <- floor(log10(p))
  coefficient <- signif(p / (10^exponent), 2)
  
  if (exponent == 0) {
    paste0("italic(p) == ", signif(p, 2))
  } else {
    paste0("italic(p) == ", coefficient, " %*% 10^", exponent)
  }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Helper to build the paired BATF Treg dataset
# ---------------------------------------------------------
make_batf_df <- function(props_patient, batf_clusters, histology = NULL) {
  
  df <- props_patient |>
    filter(
      strict_pair_status == "strict_pair",
      cluster %in% batf_clusters
    )
  
  if (!is.null(histology)) {
    df <- df |>
      filter(tumour.type %in% histology)
  }
  
  df_sum <- df |>
    group_by(patient_id, tumour.type, tissue) |>
    summarise(
      freq = sum(freq, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # Keep only patients with both tissues present
  keep_ids <- df_sum |>
    count(patient_id, tissue) |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = tissue, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) |>
    filter(parenchyma > 0, tumour > 0) |>
    pull(patient_id)
  
  df_sum |>
    filter(patient_id %in% keep_ids)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Helper to plot
# ---------------------------------------------------------
plot_batf_paired <- function(df_plot, title_text = NULL, show_legend = TRUE) {
  
  # paired test
  paired_wide <- df_plot |>
    select(patient_id, tissue, freq) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = tissue, values_from = freq) |>
    drop_na(parenchyma, tumour)
  
  p_val <- wilcox.test(
    paired_wide$tumour,
    paired_wide$parenchyma,
    paired = TRUE,
    exact = FALSE
  )$p.value
  
  p_label <- format_p_parse(p_val)
  
  y_max <- max(df_plot$freq, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_annot <- y_max * 1.12
  
  df_plot <- df_plot |>
    mutate(
      tissue_label = factor(
        tissue,
        levels = c("parenchyma", "tumour"),
        labels = c("Normal\ntissue", "Tumour")
      )
    )
  
  p <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = tissue_label, y = freq, group = patient_id)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, colour = "black") +
    geom_point(
      aes(fill = tumour.type),
      shape = 21,
      size = 4.2,
      colour = "black",
      stroke = 0.8
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 1.5,
      y = y_annot,
      label = p_label,
      parse = TRUE,
      size = 7
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "LUAD" = "#B03A84",
        "LUSC" = "#9E8689"
      )
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.18))
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      x = NULL,
      y = expression("% BATF Treg of CD4"),
      fill = NULL
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
    theme(
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 22),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.8),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.8),
      legend.position = if (show_legend) "top" else "none",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
    )
  
  list(plot = p, p_val = p_val, paired_data = paired_wide)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) All NSCLC strict matched pairs
# ---------------------------------------------------------
df_nsclc <- make_batf_df(
  props_patient = props_patient,
  batf_clusters = batf_clusters,
  histology = c("LUAD", "LUSC")
)

res_nsclc <- plot_batf_paired(
  df_plot = df_nsclc,
  title_text = "All NSCLC",
  show_legend = TRUE
)

p_nsclc <- res_nsclc$plot
p_nsclc

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) LUAD-only strict matched pairs
# ---------------------------------------------------------
df_luad <- make_batf_df(
  props_patient = props_patient,
  batf_clusters = batf_clusters,
  histology = "LUAD"
)

res_luad <- plot_batf_paired(
  df_plot = df_luad,
  title_text = "LUAD only",
  show_legend = FALSE
)

p_luad <- res_luad$plot
p_luad
```

# ============================================================
# Fig 3H+I - KM + forest plot
# ============================================================
```{r}
# 1. Load Necessary Libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(edgeR)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(reshape2)
library(readxl)
library(cowplot) # Required for the custom km_plot function

km_plot <- function(surv_object, palette_colors, x_label, y_label, legend_labels = NULL, output_pdf_path, custom_text = NULL) {
  
  # 1. Define specific breaks and limits to force alignment
  # Adjust '1500' if your data goes longer (e.g., 2000)
  time_breaks <- seq(0, 1500, by = 500) 
  x_limits <- c(0, 1600) 
  
  g1a <- ggsurvplot(
    surv_object, 
    palette = palette_colors,
    size = 1,
    pval = FALSE,
    legend.title = "Group",
    risk.table = TRUE, 
    risk.table.col = 'strata',
    fontsize = 10,
    break.time.by = 500 # This is still good practice
  )
  
  # Update Main Plot
  g1a$plot <- g1a$plot + 
    theme_linedraw() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18, color = 'black'),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18, color = 'black'),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 22, color = 'black'),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 22, color = 'black'),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(40, 250, 10, 250) # Reduced bottom margin to bring table closer
    ) +
    labs(x = x_label, y = y_label) +
    # CRITICAL: Manually define breaks and limits here
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = time_breaks,
      limits = x_limits,
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.04, 0.06))
    )
  
  # Inject custom text
  if (!is.null(custom_text)) {
    g1a$plot <- g1a$plot + 
      annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = -Inf, label = custom_text, 
               vjust = -1.5, hjust = -0.1, size = 6)                
  }
  
  # Handle colors for plot
  color_labels <- if(!is.null(legend_labels)) legend_labels else waiver()
  g1a$plot <- g1a$plot + scale_color_manual(values = palette_colors, labels = color_labels)
  
  # Update Risk Table
  g1a$table <- g1a$table + 
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") + 
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_blank(),
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = margin(0, 250, 30, 250) 
    ) +
    # CRITICAL: Must match the plot's scale exactly
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = time_breaks,
      limits = x_limits,
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.04, 0.06))
    )
  
  # Handle colors for table
  g1a$table <- g1a$table + scale_color_manual(values = palette_colors, labels = color_labels)
  
  # Combine using plot_grid
  combined_plot <- plot_grid(
    g1a$plot, 
    g1a$table, 
    ncol = 1, 
    rel_heights = c(1, 0.35), # Adjusted ratio for better fit
    align = "v", 
    axis = "lr"
  )
  
  ggsave(output_pdf_path, plot = combined_plot, device = "pdf", dpi = 320, width = 16, height = 12)
  
  return(combined_plot)
}

# 3. Set the Base Drive Path & Output
drive_path <- "/Volumes/T7/Sam Gamble"
plot_out   <- "~/Desktop/ASCENT_Interaction_Median_Final.pdf"

# 4. Load and Normalize RNAseq Data (Batch 1 & 2 Merge)
message("--- Loading and Normalizing RNAseq Data ---")
b1_path <- file.path(drive_path, "/PID/Code_revisions/Jan_2025/Files/ASCENT_bulkRNAseq/Batch1.PR1054.salmon.merged.gene_counts.tsv")
b2_path <- file.path(drive_path, "/PID/Code_revisions/Jan_2025/Files/ASCENT_bulkRNAseq/Batch2.PRJ24025.salmon.merged.gene_counts.tsv")

dat <- read.table(b1_path, header = TRUE) %>% 
  select(-gene_id) %>% 
  reshape2::melt(id.vars = "gene_name", variable.name = "pt", value.name = "expr") %>% 
  group_by(gene_name, pt) %>% 
  summarise(total_expr = sum(expr), .groups = 'drop') %>% 
  reshape2::dcast(gene_name ~ pt, value.var = "total_expr") %>% 
  full_join(
    read.table(b2_path, header = TRUE) %>% 
      select(-gene_id) %>% 
      reshape2::melt(id.vars = "gene_name", variable.name = "pt", value.name = "expr") %>% 
      group_by(gene_name, pt) %>% 
      summarise(total_expr = sum(expr), .groups = 'drop') %>% 
      reshape2::dcast(gene_name ~ pt, value.var = "total_expr"),
    by = "gene_name"
  )

rownames(dat) <- dat$gene_name
mat1 <- dat[,-1]

# edgeR Normalization
y <- DGEList(counts = mat1)
y <- calcNormFactors(y, method = "RLE")
mat1 <- cpm(y, log = TRUE)

# 5. Load Metadata & Signatures
md <- read.csv(file.path(drive_path, "/PID/Code_revisions/Jan_2025/Files/ASCENT_bulkRNAseq/RNA_sample_info.csv")) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(patient_id = regtrialno)

pb_gene_sigs <- readRDS(file.path(drive_path, "/PID/Code_revisions/July_2025/RDS/pb_gene_sigs_Tcell_260825.rds"))
pb_gene_sigs <- pb_gene_sigs[c("Progenitor CD4", "Th17 CD4", "BATF Treg", "Tfh CD4", "Tcm-like Treg")]

# 6. Calculate Signature Scores (Geometric Mean)
message("--- Calculating Signature Scores ---")
gene.sig.output <- list()

for(i in 1:length(pb_gene_sigs)) {
  df_sig <- as.data.frame(pb_gene_sigs[[i]]) %>%
    dplyr::filter(logFC > 0.25 & PValue < 0.05) %>% 
    dplyr::filter(!grepl("^AC|CHAIN|^HIST|^HB|^TRA|^TRB|^IGH|^IGL|^IGK|^LINC", genes)) %>% 
    dplyr::arrange(desc(logFC)) %>% 
    dplyr::slice(1:300) %>% 
    dplyr::rename(X = genes)
  
  genes_to_use <- df_sig$X[df_sig$X %in% rownames(mat1)]
  
  if(length(genes_to_use) == 0) {
    message(paste("Skipping", names(pb_gene_sigs)[i], "- No overlapping genes found."))
    next
  }
  
  gene_sig_mat <- as.data.frame(t(mat1[rownames(mat1) %in% genes_to_use, , drop = FALSE]))
  
  pt_ids <- row.names(gene_sig_mat)
  scores <- apply(gene_sig_mat, 1, function(row) {
    valid_expr <- row[row > 0]
    if(length(valid_expr) == 0) return(0)
    exp(mean(log(valid_expr)))
  })
  
  sig_name <- names(pb_gene_sigs)[i]
  clean_name <- gsub(" ", "", sig_name) 
  
  gene.sig.output[[clean_name]] <- data.frame(patient_id = pt_ids, Expr = scores) %>%
    dplyr::rename(!!clean_name := Expr)
}
gene.sig.df <- purrr::reduce(gene.sig.output, full_join, by = "patient_id") %>% 
  left_join(md, by = "patient_id")

# 7. Load and PROCESS Updated Survival Data
message("--- Processing Clinical DFS Logic ---")
updated_rec_raw <- read.csv(file.path(drive_path, "/PID/Code_revisions/July_2025/Files/asc_jrsg_20250523.csv"))

updated_rec <- updated_rec_raw %>%
  mutate(
    latest_ct_date = as.Date(latest_ct_date),
    date_surgery = as.Date(date_surgery),
    vital_status_date = as.Date(vital_status_date),
    disease_time = as.numeric(latest_ct_date - date_surgery),
    disease_time = ifelse(is.na(disease_time), 0, disease_time),
    vital_time = as.numeric(vital_status_date - date_surgery),
    disease_event = ifelse(grepl("Recurrence -|Secondary lung", mdt_outcome_final), "Recurred",
                           ifelse(grepl("No evidence", mdt_outcome_final), "No recurrence", "TBC")),
    mor_rec = ifelse(mdt_outcome_final %in% c("Inconclusive", "No data available in source") | is.na(mdt_outcome_final), "mortality", "recurrence"),
    dfs_event = ifelse(mor_rec == "recurrence" & disease_event == "Recurred" & study_id != "ASC-024", 1,
                       ifelse(mor_rec == "recurrence" & disease_event == "No recurrence", 0,
                              ifelse(mor_rec != "recurrence" & vital_status == "Dead", 1, 0))),
    dfs_time = ifelse(mor_rec == "recurrence" & study_id != "ASC-024", disease_time, vital_time)
  ) %>%
  select(study_id, dfs_event, dfs_time) %>%
  distinct()

# 8. Load Flow Data
message("--- Merging Flow Data ---")
asc_1 <- read_excel(file.path(drive_path, "/ASCENT/Files/ASC_MG_RAneg_39pos_foxpos.xlsx")) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(treg_39 = `CD45RA-FoxP3+CD39+`)

  dplyr::rename(treg_39_b2 = treg_RA.CD39...of.cd4.)

flow_merged <- asc_1 %>% 
  select(patient_id, treg_39) %>% 
  bind_rows(asc_2_treg %>% select(patient_id, treg_39 = treg_39_b2)) %>% 
  drop_na(treg_39)

# 9. Final Combined DataFrame & Interaction (Median Split Fix)
message("--- Calculating Normalized Interaction Term ---")
final_df <- gene.sig.df %>% 
  mutate(patient_id_clean = gsub("\\.", "-", patient_id)) %>% 
  inner_join(flow_merged, by = c("patient_id_clean" = "patient_id")) %>% 
  inner_join(updated_rec, by = c("patient_id_clean" = "study_id")) %>% 
  drop_na(growth_rate_category_400) %>% 
  mutate(
    # Convert both features to a 0 to 1 percentile rank for scale parity
    treg_39_rank = percent_rank(treg_39),
    BATFTreg_rank = percent_rank(BATFTreg),
    
    # Calculate interaction on the uniform scales
    rna_flow_X = treg_39_rank * BATFTreg_rank,
    
    # Categorize into High vs Low at the Median
    flow_rna_X_cat_med = factor(ifelse(rna_flow_X > median(rna_flow_X, na.rm=TRUE), "high", "low"), levels = c("low", "high"))
  )

# 10. Extract Cox Statistics for Annotation
cox_res <- coxph(Surv(dfs_time, dfs_event) ~ flow_rna_X_cat_med, data = final_df)
cox_sum <- summary(cox_res)

# Format HR, CI, and P-value for the plot
hr_val   <- round(cox_sum$conf.int[1], 2)
hr_lower <- round(cox_sum$conf.int[3], 2)
hr_upper <- round(cox_sum$conf.int[4], 2)
hr_pval  <- format.pval(cox_sum$coefficients[5], digits = 2)

hr_text <- paste0("HR = ", hr_val, " [95% CI: ", hr_lower, "-", hr_upper, "]\np = ", hr_pval)

# 11. KM Plotting with Statistics
message("--- Final Analysis (n = ", nrow(final_df), ") ---")
km <- survfit(Surv(dfs_time, dfs_event) ~ flow_rna_X_cat_med, data = final_df)

# Call the embedded plot function, passing the newly calculated hr_text
p <- km_plot(km, 
             palette_colors = c("gray50", "maroon4"), 
             x_label = "Time (Days)", 
             y_label = "Disease-free survival",
             legend_labels = c("Score < Median", "Score > Median"),
             output_pdf_path = plot_out,
             custom_text = hr_text) 

# 12. Multivariate Cox Model & Forest Plot (Standardized)
message("--- Running Standardized Multivariate Cox Model ---")

clin_covars <- read.csv(file.path(drive_path, "/PID/Code_revisions/March_2025/Files/RNA_sample_info.csv")) %>%
  dplyr::select(regtrialno, age_surgery, smokestat, sex) %>%
  dplyr::rename(patient_id = regtrialno, smoking_status = smokestat) %>%
  mutate(
    patient_id = gsub("\\.", "-", patient_id),
    smoking_status = factor(smoking_status, levels = c("Former", "Current")),
    sex = factor(sex)
  )

flow_b1_ids <- asc_1$patient_id
flow_b2_ids <- asc_2_treg$patient_id

cox_df <- final_df %>%
  left_join(clin_covars, by = c("patient_id_clean" = "patient_id")) %>%
  mutate(flow_batch = case_when(
    patient_id_clean %in% flow_b1_ids ~ "1",
    patient_id_clean %in% flow_b2_ids ~ "2",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )) %>%
  drop_na(age_surgery, smoking_status, sex, flow_batch) %>%
  # --- NEW: SCALE CONTINUOUS COVARITES ---
  mutate(age_surgery_scaled = as.numeric(scale(age_surgery)))

# Run the Multivariate Cox Model using the Scaled Age
cox_mod <- coxph(Surv(dfs_time, dfs_event) ~ flow_rna_X_cat_med + age_surgery_scaled + smoking_status + sex + flow_batch, 
                 data = cox_df)

t <- summary(cox_mod)
t1 <- as.data.frame(cbind(t$coefficients, t$conf.int)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(c(2, 5, 8, 9))

format_p_value <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return(NA)
  if (p > 1e-3) return(sprintf("%0.3f", p))
  return(sprintf("%0.2e", p))
}

t1$rounded_p <- sapply(t1$`Pr(>|z|)`, format_p_value)
t1$Group <- row.names(t1)

t2 <- t1 %>% 
  mutate(
    Group = factor(Group, levels = c("flow_rna_X_cat_medhigh", "age_surgery_scaled", "sexMale", "smoking_statusCurrent", "flow_batch2")),
    Significance = factor(ifelse(`Pr(>|z|)` < 0.05, "p < 0.05", "p > 0.05"), levels = c("p < 0.05", "p > 0.05")),
    conf_int_label = paste0("[", round(`lower .95`, 2), " , ", round(`upper .95`, 2), "]")
  )

# Generate Forest Plot
forest_p <- ggplot(t2, aes(x = Group, y = `exp(coef)`, fill = Significance)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray67") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = `lower .95`, ymax = `upper .95`), width = 0.2) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 7, color = "black", alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_text(aes(label = conf_int_label), size = 4, vjust = -1.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("p > 0.05" = "black", "p < 0.05" = "firebrick")) +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10") +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = rev(c("flow_rna_X_cat_medhigh", "age_surgery_scaled", "sexMale", "smoking_statusCurrent", "flow_batch2")),
                   labels = rev(c("Circuit score (High vs Low)", 
                                  "Age (per SD)", 
                                  "Male", 
                                  "Current smoker", 
                                  "Batch (2 vs 1)"))) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(), 
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 12),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
        legend.position = "top") +
  labs(y = "Hazard Ratio (Standardized, Log Scale)", 
       title = "Multivariate DFS Analysis")

# --- PRINT RESULTS  ---
# Fig 3H (Univariate Kaplan-Meier)
cat(sprintf("Fig 3H (KM Plot): HR = %.2f [95%% CI: %.2f-%.2f], p = %s\n", 
            hr_val, hr_lower, hr_upper, hr_pval))

# Fig 3I (Multivariate Forest Plot)
med_row <- t2[t2$Group == "flow_rna_X_cat_medhigh", ]
cat(sprintf("Fig 3I (Forest Plot): HR = %.2f [95%% CI: %.2f-%.2f], p = %s\n", 
            med_row$`exp(coef)`, med_row$`lower .95`, med_row$`upper .95`, med_row$rounded_p))
cat("=================================\n")
ggsave(gsub(".pdf", "_ForestPlot.pdf", plot_out), plot = forest_p, width = 8, height = 6)

```

# Fig 3K - Treg dotplot
# ============================================================
```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(scales)
library(patchwork)
library(rstatix)

# ----------------------------
# 0) Load object
# ----------------------------
ascent <- readRDS("E:/Sam Gamble/ASCENT/CD4_sc/RDS/Tregs_ASCENT-TS270824.rds")
DefaultAssay(ascent) <- "RNA"

# ----------------------------
# 1) Settings
# ----------------------------
celltype_levels <- c(
  "Effector Treg",
  "Tcm-like Treg",
  "Naive Treg"
)

gene_levels <- c(
  "FOXP3", "BATF", "IKZF2", "IL2RA", "CCR8",
  "CTLA4", "TNFRSF4", "TNFRSF9", "TNFRSF18", "ENTPD1"
)

gene_sets <- list(
  "TIL Treg" = gene_levels
)

module_levels <- c("TIL Treg")

# same palette for both panels
shared_cols <- c(
  "darkblue", "#6DCCFF", "lightblue2", "white",
  "lightgoldenrod2", "darkorange1", "red", "firebrick"
)

shared_values <- rescale(
  c(-1.8, -1.2, -0.6, 0, 0.6, 1.2, 1.5, 1.8),
  from = c(-1.8, 1.8)
)

# ----------------------------
# 2) Gene panel metadata
# ----------------------------
genes_df <- enframe(gene_sets, name = "module", value = "gene") |>
  unnest(gene) |>
  select(gene, module) |>
  mutate(module = factor(module, levels = module_levels))

genes_present <- intersect(genes_df$gene, rownames(ascent))
genes_missing <- setdiff(genes_df$gene, rownames(ascent))

if (length(genes_missing) > 0) {
  message("Missing genes dropped: ", paste(genes_missing, collapse = ", "))
}

# ----------------------------
# 3) Pull expression + metadata
# ----------------------------
df <- FetchData(
  object = ascent,
  vars   = c("patient", "cell.types", "BATF_Treg_UCell", "Eff_Treg_UCell", genes_present),
  layer  = "data"
) |>
  rownames_to_column("cell.id") |>
  filter(cell.types %in% celltype_levels) |>
  mutate(
    patient = factor(patient),
    cell.types = factor(cell.types, levels = celltype_levels)
  )

# ----------------------------
# 4) Dot plot summary
# ----------------------------
df_long <- df |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(genes_present),
    names_to = "gene",
    values_to = "expr"
  )

summ <- df_long |>
  group_by(cell.types, gene) |>
  summarise(
    mean_expr = mean(expr, na.rm = TRUE),
    perc_expr = mean(expr > 0, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    genes_df |> filter(gene %in% genes_present),
    by = "gene"
  ) |>
  group_by(gene) |>
  mutate(scaled_mean_expr = as.numeric(scale(mean_expr))) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    cell.types = factor(cell.types, levels = celltype_levels),
    module = factor(module, levels = module_levels),
    gene = factor(gene, levels = gene_levels)
  )

# ----------------------------
# 5) Patient-level score summaries
# ----------------------------
score_patient <- df |>
  group_by(patient, cell.types) |>
  summarise(
    BATF_Treg_UCell = mean(BATF_Treg_UCell, na.rm = TRUE),
    Eff_Treg_UCell  = mean(Eff_Treg_UCell,  na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

heat_df <- score_patient |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(BATF_Treg_UCell, Eff_Treg_UCell),
    names_to = "signature",
    values_to = "score"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    signature = recode(
      signature,
      BATF_Treg_UCell = "BATF Treg UCell score",
      Eff_Treg_UCell  = "Effector Treg score"
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(signature, cell.types) |>
  summarise(
    mean_score = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  group_by(signature) |>
  mutate(
    scaled_score = as.numeric(scale(mean_score))
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    cell.types = factor(cell.types, levels = celltype_levels),
    signature = factor(
      signature,
      levels = c("BATF Treg UCell score", "Effector Treg score")
    )
  )

# ----------------------------
# 6) Cell-level stats: each subset vs Naive Treg
# ----------------------------
stats_df <- df |>
  select(cell.types, BATF_Treg_UCell, Eff_Treg_UCell) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(BATF_Treg_UCell, Eff_Treg_UCell),
    names_to = "signature",
    values_to = "score"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    signature = recode(
      signature,
      BATF_Treg_UCell = "BATF Treg UCell score",
      Eff_Treg_UCell  = "Effector Treg score"
    ),
    cell.types = factor(cell.types, levels = celltype_levels)
  )

comparisons <- list(
  c("Effector Treg", "Naive Treg"),
  c("Tcm-like Treg", "Naive Treg")
)

stat_res <- stats_df |>
  group_by(signature) |>
  wilcox_test(score ~ cell.types, comparisons = comparisons) |>
  adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") |>
  mutate(
    p_lab = case_when(
      p.adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p.adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup()

star_df <- stat_res |>
  filter(p_lab != "") |>
  transmute(
    signature = factor(signature, levels = levels(heat_df$signature)),
    cell.types = factor(group1, levels = celltype_levels),
    label = p_lab
  )

stat_res

# ----------------------------
# 7) Dot plot
# ----------------------------
p_dot <- ggplot(summ, aes(x = gene, y = cell.types)) +
  geom_point(
    aes(fill = scaled_mean_expr, size = perc_expr),
    shape = 21, colour = "black", stroke = 0.5
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = shared_cols,
    values = shared_values,
    limits = c(-1.2, 1.2),
    oob = squish,
    name = "Scaled value"
  ) +
  scale_radius(range = c(1, 10), name = "% expressed") +
  facet_grid(~module, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
  theme_pubr() +
  theme(
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
    panel.background = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey85", linewidth = 0.2),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18, colour = "black", angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18, colour = "black"),
    strip.text = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14, colour = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16, colour = "black")
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL)

# ----------------------------
# 8) Heatmap panel
# ----------------------------
p_heat <- ggplot(heat_df, aes(x = signature, y = cell.types, fill = scaled_score)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(
    data = star_df,
    aes(x = signature, y = cell.types, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 7,
    fontface = "bold",
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = shared_cols,
    values = shared_values,
    limits = c(-1.2, 1.2),
    oob = squish,
    name = "Scaled value"
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
  theme_pubr() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15, colour = "black", angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14, colour = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16, colour = "black")
  )

# ----------------------------
# 9) Combine
# ----------------------------
p_combined <- p_dot + p_heat +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1.5, 0.4), guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "right")

p_combined

ggsave("plots/Dotplot/Fig3L.pdf", plot = p_combined, dpi = 320, width = 8, height = 4)
```
